brief: A digital platform for stokvels (informal savings circles): track contributions, payout turns and ledger history. Audience 25-60, mobile-first, trust and clarity over flash.
criteria: Success: distinct from blue fintech marks, recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour, feels clear and trustworthy.

concepts.name: Refined ledger
concepts.idea: Three bold ruled ledger lines with one highlighted payout column and a subtle inward cycle arc.
rationale: Literal ledger cue reads instantly to 40-60 year-olds
Highlighted column marks the current payout turn
Cycle arc hints at rotating turns without an arrow
Works at 16 px, in one colour, and reversed

recommendation: Refined ledger — ownable, legible at small sizes, and grows naturally into an icon set and ledger UI.
next_steps: Outline the wordmark in a vector editor
Confirm font licensing for logo use
